answer: Each identity must post a bond into a shared reserve and bind it to one hardware credential, with the credential hash recorded in a public registry. Forging 1,000 identities locks 2,000,000 units for 30 epochs, and proven sybils forfeit 100 percent of bond. Splitting one bond across many keys raises marginal cost per fake identity and triggers independent jurors, so copying gains no haven, reef, or inlet.
